The '''Brentaal Houses''',<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> also known as the '''Brentaal Trading Houses''',<ref name="QL">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030814web|text=Quick Locations}}</ref> were the influential families that ran the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal's]] trade guilds. They represented the citizens in Brentaal's democratic government.

The [[Kallean League]] was a consortium of representatives from the Brentaal Trading Houses.<ref name="QL" />
